chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Ya'qub ibn 'Uthaym, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abd Allāh عليه السلام: A gecko was found, and we found that it had decomposed in the well. He said: You are only required to draw seven buckets from it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a decomposed gecko is found in a well?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a well in which a decomposed gecko is found. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that seven buckets of water should be drawn from the well, indicating the prescribed measure for purification in this case.
